# hiok_container_app (Resource)

A Container App: an image run as a named, addressable service.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `image` (String)
- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `cloudflare_enabled` (Boolean) Serve through the CDN.
- `custom_domain` (String) A domain of yours to serve the app on.
- `dapr_app_id` (String)
- `dapr_enabled` (Boolean) Run a Dapr sidecar.
- `environment_id` (String) Environment to join. Apps sharing one address each other by name.
- `environment_variables` (Map of String)
- `external_ingress` (Boolean) Publish a host port. Leave false and the app is reachable only from inside its environment — no port is published at all.
- `health_check` (String) jsonencode({path = "/healthz", intervalSeconds = 10})
- `max_replicas` (Number)
- `min_replicas` (Number)
- `otel_enabled` (Boolean) Inject OpenTelemetry settings pointing at the region's collector.
- `ram_gb` (Number)
- `region` (String)
- `resource_group_id` (String) Resource group the resource is placed in.
- `sidecars` (String) Sidecar containers (JSON).
- `subscription_id` (String) Subscription the resource is billed to.
- `target_port` (Number)
- `vcpu` (Number)
- `volumes` (String) Volume mounts (JSON).

### Read-Only

- `default_hostname` (String)
- `host_port` (Number) Published port, or 0 for an app without external ingress.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `status` (String)
